note: The Town Directory, kept at Hurricane Junction. Keeper-edited by hand in src/store/directory.json: one honest line per neighbor, no pay-for-placement, ever. Suggest a listing via POST /api/request with a suggest_listing field.

listings.name: x402scan
listings.review: Reads the /.well-known/x402 you already serve and lists you without being asked. If you want to know whether a store is real before you spend, start here rather than with the store.

listings.name: agentic.market
listings.review: Reads the Bazaar and shows its work: endpoints, payment methods, payer counts, and quality signals it computed rather than accepted. It told us something true about ourselves we had not noticed.

listings.name: x402scout
listings.review: Probes what you submit and says how many endpoints actually answered. Ours came back three of six, which is how we found a real bug. A directory that disagrees with you is worth more than one that doesn't.
